oral_examination.oral_examination: 35. Residual crown, defective and subgingival. When percussed, the teeth are not loose and the gums are slightly red and swollen. CBCT showed a dark shadow at the root tip.

treatment_plan.notes: Pay attention to oral hygiene and return to the clinic regularly.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. 2% lidocaine block anesthesia, 4% articaine local infiltration anesthesia, gingival separation, gap expansion, loosening, extraction by pulling method, two sutures, and compression to stop bleeding.
